records.name: Kanut
records.facts_used: Rajandi groups Kanut with Kanuth, Knud and Knut, and gives the Latinized form Canutus. This locates the name in a northern European family; an old dictionary’s competing lexical glosses need not be turned into one certain literal meaning. The form and its relationships are documented in Edgar Rajandi’s Raamat nimedest, published in Tallinn in 1966. The book records the naming traditions known at that time. Its publication date documents a linguistic treatment, rather than the name’s invention or its first birth registration.

records.name: Nuut
